===================================================================
--- completions/ox.bash	
+++ completions/ox.bash	
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+# bash completion for ox
+# Source me: source completions/ox.bash
+# Or install: cp completions/ox.bash /etc/bash_completion.d/ox
+
+_ox_completions()
+{
+    local cur prev words cword
+    _init_completion || return
+
+    local options="--help -h --version -v --config -c --readonly -r --filetype -f --stdin --config-assist"
+
+    case $prev in
+        --config|-c)
+            # Complete config file paths
+            _filedir '@(lua|conf|cfg|oxrc|txt|*)'
+            return
+            ;;
+        --filetype|-f)
+            # Complete known file types
+            local fts="ABAP Ada AutoHotkey AppleScript Arc ASP ActionScript AGS\ Script \
+                Assembly Awk Batch Brainfuck C CMake Cobol Java Clojure CoffeeScript Crystal \
+                Cuda C++ C# CSS CSV D Dart Diff Dockerfile Elixir Elm Emacs\ Lisp ERB Erlang \
+                F# FORTRAN Fish Forth ANTLR GDScript GLSL Gnuplot Go Groovy HLSL C\ Header \
+                Haml Handlebars Haskell C++\ Header HTML INI Arduino J JSON JSX JavaScript \
+                Julia Kotlin LLVM Lex Lua LiveScript LOLCODE Common\ Lisp Log\ file M4 Groff \
+                Matlab Nushell Objective-C OCaml Makefile Markdown Nix NumPy OpenCL PHP \
+                Pascal Perl PowerShell Prolog Python Cython R reStructuredText Racket Ruby \
+                Rust Shell SCSS SQL Sass Scala Scheme Smalltalk Swift TOML Tcl TeX TypeScript \
+                Plain\ Text Vala Visual\ Basic Vue Logos XML Yacc Yaml Bison Zsh"
+            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$fts" -- "$cur"))
+            return
+            ;;
+        --readonly|-r|--stdin|--config-assist|--help|-h|--version|-v)
+            # These flags take no arguments
+            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$options" -- "$cur"))
+            return
+            ;;
+    esac
+
+    if [[ $cur == -* ]]; then
+        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$options" -- "$cur"))
+    else
+        # Complete file names by default
+        _filedir
+    fi
+}
+
+complete -F _ox_completions ox

--- plugins/autocomplete.lua	
+++ plugins/autocomplete.lua	
@@ -0,0 +1,523 @@
+--[[
+autocomplete v0.1
+
+Word prediction based on language keyword dictionaries
+plus words already in the current document.
+
+Trigger: Ctrl+Space (configurable)
+
+To customize keywords for a file type, add to the keywords table:
+  keywords["MyLang"] = { "kw1", "kw2", ... }
+]]--
+
+autocomplete = {}
+
+-- Built-in keyword dictionaries for programming languages
+autocomplete.keywords = {
+    ["Rust"] = {

+
+-- Get keywords for current file type
+function autocomplete:get_language_keywords()
+    local doc_type = editor.document_type
+    local keywords = self.keywords[doc_type]
+    if not keywords then
+        local alias = self.aliases[doc_type]
+        if alias then
+            keywords = self.keywords[alias]
+        end
+    end
+    return keywords or {}
+end
+
+-- Get all words from the current document
+function autocomplete:get_document_words()
+    local words = editor:get_document_words()
+    return words or {}
+end
+
+-- Combine keywords + document words into a single completion list
+-- Removes duplicates and sorts by relevance (keywords first)
+function autocomplete:build_candidates()
+    local lang_kws = self:get_language_keywords()
+    local doc_words = self:get_document_words()
+    local seen = {}
+    local candidates = {}
+
+    -- Add language keywords first (higher priority)
+    for _, word in ipairs(lang_kws) do
+        if not seen[word] then
+            seen[word] = true
+            candidates[#candidates + 1] = word
+        end
+    end
+
+    -- Add document words
+    for _, word in ipairs(doc_words) do
+        if not seen[word] then
+            seen[word] = true
+            candidates[#candidates + 1] = word
+        end
+    end
+
+    -- Add common programming words
+    for _, word in ipairs(self.common) do
+        if not seen[word] then
+            candidates[#candidates + 1] = word
+        end
+    end
+
+    return candidates
+end
+
+-- Trigger autocomplete
+function autocomplete:trigger()
+    local candidates = self:build_candidates()
+    if #candidates == 0 then
+        return
+    end
+    editor:complete_word(candidates)
+end
+
+-- Bind to Ctrl+Space (or alt_space if ctrl_space not available)
+event_mapping["ctrl_space"] = function()
+    autocomplete:trigger()
+end
